dossier_meta.catalog_title: Combinatorial polynomial-time algorithm for MWIS in perfect graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Design a combinatorial polynomial-time algorithm for the Maximum Weight Independent Set problem in perfect graphs.
dossier_meta.context_text: The polynomial-time algorithm of Grötschel, Lovász, and Schrijver for MWIS in perfect graphs relies on the ellipsoid method. The authors explicitly note that designing a combinatorial polynomial-time algorithm for this problem remains an important open problem.
